question: Who has been honoured with the ACES 2025 Lifetime Achievement Award for leadership and impact across Asia?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Shardul S. Shroff.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Dr. Shardul S. Shroff, Executive Chairman of Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co., received the ACES 2025 Lifetime Achievement Award at Jimbaran Bay, Bali.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Recipient: Dr. Shardul S. Shroff.**
 
• **Honoured with ACES 2025 Lifetime Achievement Award.**
 
• **Award recognises outstanding leadership, governance, and impact in Asia.**
 
• **Ceremony held in Jimbaran Bay, Bali.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **ACES (Asia Corporate Excellence & Sustainability Awards)**__

 __
 
• Prestigious Asia-wide leadership & sustainability recognition.
 
• Founded in 2014; honours influential leaders & corporations.
 
• Backed by research-driven assessment methodology.
 
 
 
• **Dr. Shardul S. Shroff**__
 __
 
• Executive Chairman, Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co. (SAM).
 
• Previously awarded National Law Day Award for corporate law contribution.
 
• Influential in policy reform, legal leadership & governance standards.
 
 
 
• **Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co.**__
 __
 
• Leading full-service law firm in India with 900+ lawyers & 188 partners.
 
• Carries ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification for data security standards.
 
• Expertise spans M&A, arbitration, competition law, finance & tech sectors.
 
 
 
• **Award Significance**__
 
 
• Validates excellence, enhances global reputation & leadership impact.
 
• Celebrates vision, governance, and sustainable business contribution.
